name: otp
title: Verification Codes
description: One-time codes from your recent text messages (Messages on macOS) or from a Wisp server, newest first, with who sent them. Enter pastes the code into the app in front; a bar item shows a new code as it arrives.
author: pal

settings.label: Source
settings.description: Where codes come from: Messages on this Mac, or a Wisp server, which finds them in every account it keeps (SMS, mail, chats).

settings.label: Wisp server
settings.description: The address of your Wisp server, as you open it in a browser.

settings.label: Wisp token
settings.description: A token from Wisp's Accounts › Agent tokens; Read is enough. Kept in the OS keychain.

settings.label: Look back
settings.description: How many hours of messages to scan for codes.

settings.label: Ignore senders
settings.description: Senders whose codes are never listed, as Messages or Wisp names them (a shortcode like AKBANK, a number, an email). Case does not matter.

settings.label: Messages database
settings.description: The chat.db to read when the source is Messages. ~ is expanded.

settings.label: Contacts database
settings.description: An AddressBook-v22.abcddb whose names replace phone numbers; empty means every source under ~/Library/Application Support/AddressBook.

otp.title: Verification Codes
otp.description: Codes from the last day, Today, Yesterday and Earlier, filtered by kind.

latest-code.title: Latest code
latest-code.description: The newest verification code on the strip for a minute after it arrives; the popover shows it large with the sender, the minute counting down and the two codes before it; Enter copies it.

store.tagline: Paste one-time codes from your text messages or Wisp
features: Codes from the last 24 hours of Messages on macOS, newest first, the sender named from Contacts
Or every code a Wisp server finds, in SMS, mail and chats, on macOS and Linux
Each code's kind (card, bank, government, delivery, shopping, sign-in) as its tile and a filter, the sender's name made readable
Spots codes in English and Turkish messages, skipping amounts, dates and phone numbers
A code that just arrived is the first row and shows up at the root
A bar item shows the newest code for a minute, with the sender and the codes before it
Copied codes stay out of clipboard history, and the previous clipboard comes back after 30 seconds

screenshots.caption: Today's codes and yesterday's: what each is for as its tile, the sender, the message, the code (grey once it has lapsed), the account it came through, how long ago
The detail pane: the code large, who sent it, what for, through which account and when, the message and how long the code is good for
Paste the code into the app in front, copy it (concealed, gone in 30 s), or copy the sender
On the menu bar: the code that just arrived, in green, for a minute
A click opens the popover: the code large, who sent it, the minute counting down, the two codes before it; Enter copies
A code forty seconds in: the bar nearly run down, the item gone twenty seconds later
On sketchybar: the key glyph and the code, both green

actions.title: Paste code
actions.description: Hides, then pastes into the app that was in front.
